description: Reference libraries for Project Arrhythmia modding
releaseNotes:
# 26.5.3 [Alpha]
Massive patch with a lot of fixes and improvements, especially for the editor. Also now all demo improvements and fixes are included in the primary branch.

[Features]
- Added right click on scrubber bar to quick add markers.
- Added snap to marker during timeline object dragging
- Added better undo support for some timeline dragging stuff.
- Reworked UI for timeline area rendering such that they are now small lines that appear in the scrubber bar.
- New trigger that allow you to add multiple intro titles or disable the intro all together.
- Ability to quickly zoom the camera in and out in the editor using the scroll wheel.
- Annotation strokes can now have different brush sizes by using [ / ] keys to adjust the brush size on the fly.

[Fixes]
- Initial rotation keyframe for particle emitters is now used to initial rotation of all particles.
- Particles now exist beyond their emitters lifespan if need be
- **Objects should now flash far less when being updated rapidly**
- When annotating you no longer can select things in the preview window.
- Far better handling of corrupt or malformed levels in the editor. Now able to surface more actionable errors to the user instead of just breaking.
- Annotations drawings now look much smoother and better in general.
- Annotations now come with a built in duration of 0.1s so they won't just disappear immediately after being drawn.

*This update doesn't include any story updates unfortunately as I'm not quite ready. It just has the public demo with the full para **(now fully fixed sorry)**!*

**Make sure to launch using the second option on alpha (swapping over from Project Arrhythmia.exe to Afterbeat.exe so this was needed to ensure default doesn't break lol)**
